title: stale DD engine cycles with resolvable IDs still produce false constraint findings
description:
After sutra/219, unresolvable file_ids in stale engine cycles are skipped. But a second staleness class remains: if a file is reparsed and its imports change (edge removed) while its row ID is preserved (normal upsert_file path), the DD engine still reports the old cycle with all IDs valid in path_map. The len() guard doesn't fire, and a false no_cycles finding is emitted for a cycle that sutra_deps no longer reports.

Reproduction: load DD engine with edges A→B→C→A, then remove the C→A import in the DB (reparse C without that import). Engine still reports the cycle; all three file IDs still exist; evaluate_dd emits a finding for a nonexistent cycle.

Root issue: evaluate_dd trusts the provided DD engine's cycles without validating them against current DB edges.
root_cause: evaluate_dd validated stale engine cycles only by checking file_id resolution in path_map (sutra/219). When files are reparsed and keep their row IDs but lose import edges, all IDs still resolve and the guard doesn't fire, producing a false no_cycles finding for a cycle that no longer exists in the current edge set.
